title: Existence proof of a nonconfining phase in four-dimensional U(1) lattice gauge theory
statement: Abstract: "A rigorous lower bound is obtained for the Wilson loop expectation value"; rest (phase transition, Z(N) consequence) not quoted by agent. Perimeter-law reading is from memory.

title: Massless phases and symmetry restoration in abelian gauge theories and spin systems
statement: Abstract: "We give a new, elementary proof for the existence of a deconfining transition to a massless (QED) phase"; power-law decay detail from memory.

title: Proof of confinement of static quarks in 3-dimensional U(1) lattice gauge theory for all values of the coupling constant
statement: Abstract: "We show that its string tension α is nonzero for all values of the coupling constant g2"; a bound on string tension and a continuum-limit statement exist in abstract but were not relayed. INSPIRE lists year 1981 (CMP vol 82).

title: Correlation decay for finite lattice gauge theories at weak coupling
locator: abstract page; Theorem 1.1 (Sec 1.3), Remark 1.2 as relayed by web-fetch agent from arxiv.org/html v3
statement: beta >= (1/Delta_G)(114+4 log|G|); covariance of conjugacy-invariant functions of holonomies in rectangles B1,B2 at l-inf distance L bounded by 4(4e24|G|^2)^(|B1|+|B2|)||f1|| ||f2|| exp(-(beta/2)Delta_G(L-1)). Finite G, possibly nonabelian, Z^4 boxes.

title: A probabilistic mechanism for quark confinement
statement: Unbroken center symmetry implies confinement; sufficient condition: nontrivial center + exponential correlation decay under arbitrary boundary conditions. Not a 2D result per se.

title: 2D Yang-Mills measure / YM2 / gauge theory on compact surfaces
statement: Recalled: 2D YM is exactly solvable (heat-kernel / Markov holonomy field); continuum limit exists for compact surfaces; area law holds. Nothing read.

title: No source read for SU(2) in d=4,5
statement: Recalled: no rigorous proof of a phase transition or its absence for SU(2) in 4D; strong-coupling confinement (Osterwalder-Seiler 1978) only. Not verified; 5D unknown to me.
